video_title: 2026 Training Camp Media Availability | Coach J.B. Bickerstaff l 10.07.26

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: J.B. Bickerstaff on the value of preseason scrimmage games
quotes.excerpt: to be able to go out and do it against another opponent who doesn't know your stuff
quotes.quote: When you're scrimmaging or playing against each other, it's always good-bad, right? Because defense gets a stop, our offense scores. But to be able to go out and do it against another opponent who doesn't know your stuff and all those things, it's great for us. And then you study it and see where the breakdowns are and then you get to handle home on those details.
quotes.social_post: Coach J.B. Bickerstaff says playing against outside opponents in the preseason is vital for the Pistons to identify defensive breakdowns and focus on details.

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: J.B. Bickerstaff on implementing new concepts during training camp
quotes.excerpt: we're introducing some new things and new concepts, and it's always expected to be that way
quotes.quote: We're introducing some new things and new concepts, and it's always expected to be that way. Typically your offense is a little bit behind your defense to start camp. But again, it's a great opportunity for us just to see it, get it on film, watch it as a group, break it down as coaches, break it down on the floor, and improve from it.
quotes.social_post: J.B. Bickerstaff notes that the Pistons are installing new offensive concepts early in camp, acknowledging that the offense is typically behind the defense at this stage.

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: J.B. Bickerstaff on Jaden Ivey's offseason development
quotes.excerpt: he's done a really good job of making small improvements all around
quotes.quote: He's done a really good job of making small improvements all around. He appears to be faster, more explosive. His face-up game has improved, his work around the basket has improved as well. Defensively being in his right spots, being switchable and being able to guard smaller guys so far, so he's looked really good.
quotes.social_post: J.B. Bickerstaff is impressed with Jaden Ivey's offseason growth, noting the guard looks faster and more explosive while showing improved defensive versatility.

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: J.B. Bickerstaff confirms Jaden Ivey will play in preseason
quotes.excerpt: the plan is definitely for him to play in the preseason
quotes.quote: The plan is definitely for him to play in the preseason. It's just one of those things that we'll always be cautious of is how he's feeling. Going from a summer workout to an NBA game, regardless if it's a preseason game, you want to be aware of his body and the work that he's putting in and making sure that we're safe and that he's feeling okay. But the plan is definitely for him to play in the preseason.
quotes.social_post: Pistons coach J.B. Bickerstaff confirms the plan is for Jaden Ivey to play in the preseason, though the team will remain cautious regarding his workload and physical health.

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: J.B. Bickerstaff on maintaining defensive foundation with roster continuity
quotes.excerpt: the foundation is the foundation and that always stays the same
quotes.quote: The foundation is the foundation and that always stays the same, especially for us defensively. We make sure that we hammer home the details of what we do on that end of the floor. And then when you get to the offensive piece of it, you spend time working on the adjustments, but you have to blend that into what your foundation is there also.
quotes.social_post: J.B. Bickerstaff says the Pistons are prioritizing their defensive foundation while working to blend new offensive adjustments into their established system.
